description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_DenyElementDecorator' that acts as a decorator for attribute validation, specifically to disable CSS properties for certain HTML elements by wrapping another attribute definition.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_DenyElementDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class implementing CSS property disabling for specific elements by wrapping another attribute definition and checking the current token in the context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a definition to wrap and an element to deny.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if the current token in the context matches the denied element; if so, disables validation, otherwise delegates to the wrapped definition.
